goal: Implement CaptureIngressContext seqlock snapshot so queued work cannot retarget (story 3.4, CAP-004/008/009, QUE-001).
outcome: Snapshot includes target PID, bundle token, activation generation, destination UUID, accept-capture generation, policy/settings revisions, route, and monotonic time; inconsistent read returns context_unavailable; focused element is not in the event-tap snapshot.

requirements.statement: Never accept ADR-002, ADR-009, or ADR-018 silently; leave them Proposed.
Do not copy Cooper source or Copper trade dress.
Event-tap callbacks must not touch AX, DB, windows, clipboard, or logging.
No network, telemetry, accounts, remote fonts, CDN, hosted AI, or analytics.
Every user-facing string belongs in the locale catalog.
Preserve requirement IDs in implementation notes, tests, and evidence.
Work only on branch bmad/bronze-autonomous; never push.
Do not invent a Swift verify command; pnpm verify is the repo bar.
Given the native façade exists, when ingress context is implemented, then the snapshot fields match the story and inconsistent read returns context_unavailable.
